hookups.source: No operator page exists (Google Maps lists no website; the Hipcamp listing is closed to bookings and states no hookups). The stored 30/50 A, water and sewer were derived from note prose resting on directory listings (Harvest Hosts, allstays), so they are cleared. Read 2026-10-30.

sites.source: Same as hookups: the 32-ft maximum came from allstays only; no operator page states a length. A June 2022 Hipcamp reviewer in a 34-ft Class A says 'be sure to call ahead to verify that your rig will fit in the sites'. Read 2026-10-30.

note: Small private campground at 75 Cozy Cove Pl, Blairsville, near Lake Nottely (a short walk, not on the water). Hosts Kim and Jeffrey also keep a garden and chickens. A June 2022 reviewer in a 34-ft Class A advised calling ahead to check that a rig fits the sites. No website. --Claude
summary: Fails the presence rule: no website (Google Maps 'Add website'), Google Maps only 4 reviews (needs 25+), and its Hipcamp listing says 'Not currently accepting bookings on Hipcamp' (newest review June 2022). RV Life has it at $$ with one review. No 2024+ rate anywhere, fees stay unset. Cleared the directory-only hookups and 32-ft max. Phone (478) 559-5674 matches Google.
flags: SUGGEST DROP - PRESENCE RULE FAILS: no website of its own (Google Maps 'Add website'; a web search finds only Hipcamp, allstays, outreserve and AAA directory pages), and Google Maps shows 'Hippie Hollow Campground' open but with only 4 reviews (rule needs 25+ with a phone). Its only booking channel, Hipcamp, now reads 'Not currently accepting bookings on Hipcamp' (newest review June 2022). RV Life: $$ tier, 1 review. Price: no 2024+ operator rate (the Harvest Hosts $35 is a member-platform listing).

SIZE: allstays lists 2 RV sites. A June 2022 Hipcamp reviewer camped there in a 34-ft Class A but warned the sites 'are adequate size, but it could be difficult for bigger vehicles to fit' - call ahead. No operator states a length.
